- Cardiomegaly is frequently identified, often described as an enlarged cardiac silhouette or moderate heart enlargement.
- Lung opacities and atelectasis are commonly observed, particularly at the lung bases.
- Pleural effusions are present in several cases and are sometimes associated with adjacent atelectasis.
- No lung lesions or acute fractures were detected in the retrieved clinical evidence.
